scope: Mechanical Mother independent procedural reconstruction from artistic or stylized third-party references
userCorrection: Learn the reference form one-to-one, especially continuous curved surfaces, but do not copy its mesh or textures and do not pretend its artistic geometry is authoritative engineering truth.

negativeControls.name: same endpoints and midpoint but different continuous curve
mix preferred halves from two artistic variants without per-part source mapping
replace an unusual visible reference curve with a generic realistic mechanical curve
promote a visible reference match to engineering-standard truth without an authority source
reuse the third-party mesh or texture because it is easier than independent reconstruction

positiveControl.input: fixed reference digests + explicit per-part variant mapping + independent procedural surface + multi-section curve/curvature receipts + hidden regions UNKNOWN + engineering truth UNKNOWN + KAOPU material route

promotionRule: A candidate may pass visible artistic-reference fidelity while engineering authenticity remains UNKNOWN. It may not normalize, simplify, mix variants, fill hidden regions or copy third-party assets without explicit authority. Production promotion additionally requires the exact E50 subject, multi-view/section evidence, independent verifier and user acceptance.
